examples.arabic: حطيت كل حاجة في الحلة الكبيرة
examples.english: I put everything in the big pot.
examples.transliteration: Hatteet kol haga fi el halla el kebeera.

examples.arabic: حطيتهم في الحلة وسمعت صوت الطشطشة
examples.english: I put them in the pot and heard the sizzling sound.
examples.transliteration: Hattett'hom fel hella we sema't sot el tashtasha

examples.arabic: حطيت كتير ملح وشوية سكر بالغلط في الحلة
examples.english: I put a lot of salt and a little sugar by mistake in the pot
examples.transliteration: Hattayt keteer malh w shewaya sukkar belghalat fel hella

examples.arabic: بياع الفُل، اللي كان شايل حلة كبيرة، ابتسم وقال بصوت عالي: صباح الخير يا ست البنات! تحبي تاكلي فُل سخن؟
examples.english: The ful vendor, who was carrying a large pot, smiled and said loudly: "Good morning, lady of all girls! Would you like to eat hot ful?"
examples.transliteration: Bayya3 el-ful, elly kan shayel 7ella kebira, ebtesem w 'al be-sout 3ali: "Sabah el-kheir ya sett el-banat! Te7ebbi takli ful sokhn?"
examples.storyTitle: Greetings in the Bustle of Khan el-Khalili

examples.arabic: بعدين حطيت اللحمة والسخن طلع من الحلة
examples.english: Then I put the meat, and heat came out of the pot.
examples.transliteration: Ba'dein hattait el-lahma wel-sokhn tala' men el-halla.
